# Source: National Archives of India, External Affairs Department, Sikkim (Political), 1930, File No. 5-P, pp. 14-15 (Abhilekh Patal NAIDLF03824535).
# Typed copies, seven groups per line. From the reader's OCR text layer, checked against screen captures of the reader (images not reproduced). 6615 (p. 14) and 7308 (p. 15) half hidden by the cursor on the captures; confirmed by the sense.
